provenance.quote: Added support for defining custom agents using Markdown files (`agent.md`) with YAML frontmatter and H1-delimited system prompts.
provenance.caveat: The format is first-party. The exact scan paths are verified from official documentation at https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/overview (.agents/agents/<name>.md, .agents/agents/<name>/agent.md, and global ~/.gemini/config/agents/).

name.semantics: Unique identifier for the custom agent. Used by invoke_subagent's TypeName parameter to target this agent.

provenance.quote: A unique, machine-readable identifier for the skill or subagent.

description.semantics: Determines when the parent agent planner delegates tasks to this subagent. Critical for progressive discovery and autonomous dispatch.

provenance.quote: A detailed explanation of what the component does and when the agent should trigger it. This is critical for the planner to delegate tasks effectively.

tools.semantics: An allowlist of permitted tool names. Presence in the list is what grants a tool capability to the agent. Listing invoke_subagent grants subagent delegation and automatically injects subagent guidance into the system prompt. Omitting write/edit tools enforces read-only execution.

provenance.quote: Added automatic subagent guidance for custom agents defined in Markdown: agents that list `invoke_subagent` in their tools now receive the roster of available subagents and usage instructions in their system prompt, so they can actually delegate to the subagents they declared.

disallowedTools.semantics: A denylist of tool names explicitly stripped from the agent's available tools pool.

provenance.quote: Defines permitted tools the agent can use. disallowedTools: Explicitly restricts specific tools.

model.semantics: Specifies the model tier the agent runs at when invoked as a subagent, defaulting to inherit (the parent's model tier).

provenance.quote: Added a `model` option to custom agent frontmatter so an agent runs at a chosen model tier (such as `flash` or `pro`) when invoked as a subagent, defaulting to `inherit` (the parent's model).

subagent.default: true for agents placed in .agents/agents/ or when omitted; explicit false prevents subagent invocation.
subagent.semantics: Explicitly gates subagent roster membership and invocation by parent agents. An agent with subagent: false cannot be invoked as a subagent.

provenance.quote: Fixed custom agents that declare `subagent: false` still appearing in the available-subagents list and being invocable as subagents.

mainAgent.semantics: Controls whether this agent definition may run as the top-level main session agent.

provenance.quote: Markdown agents support `mainAgent`, `subagent`, `hidden`, `inheritMcp`, and `commandExecutionPolicy` frontmatter fields for fine-grained control over agent behavior.

effort.semantics: Reasoning effort depth. Supported as an interactive slash command (/effort) and per-invocation flag, but per-agent frontmatter reasoning effort is not verified in custom agent frontmatter.

provenance.caveat: Effort is an interactive CLI command and session flag; absence of frontmatter enforcement across changelog and documentation. Declared supported: false so disclosures accurately reflect host behavior.

commandExecutionPolicy.semantics: Governs autonomous command execution policy (e.g., sandbox, auto).

provenance.quote: Markdown agents support `mainAgent`, `subagent`, `hidden`, `inheritMcp`, and `commandExecutionPolicy` frontmatter fields for fine-grained control over agent behavior.
provenance.caveat: The full enumeration of accepted values is not published as a closed set.

excludeDefaultComponents.semantics: Opts out of default prompt sections and built-in tools while preserving post-invocation hooks. Allows custom agents to operate with minimal ambient surface.

provenance.quote: Added support for `excludeDefaultComponents: true` in custom agent Markdown frontmatter, allowing custom agents to opt out of default prompt sections and built-in tools while preserving post-invocation hooks.

agents.semantics: Explicit dependency list of subagents this agent depends on, resolved using workspace-relative, absolute, or agent-relative path rules.

provenance.quote: Added an `agents` list to custom agent Markdown frontmatter, letting an agent declare the subagents it depends on using the same workspace-relative, absolute, and agent-relative path rules as `skills`.

rules.semantics: Names rule files directly instead of inheriting the entire rule tree; rules named this way always apply.

provenance.quote: Added a `rules:` key to markdown agent frontmatter, so an agent can name rule files directly instead of inheriting your whole rule tree; a rule named this way always applies.

inheritCustomizations.semantics: Single switch deciding whether the agent adopts skills, rules, plugins, subagents, and MCP servers, replacing per-kind defaults.

provenance.quote: a single `inheritCustomizations` switch that decides whether the agent adopts your skills, rules, plugins, subagents and MCP servers, replacing per-kind defaults that silently disagreed with each other

hidden.semantics: Hides the agent from the /agents picker list when true.

provenance.quote: Markdown agents support `mainAgent`, `subagent`, `hidden`, `inheritMcp`, and `commandExecutionPolicy` frontmatter fields for fine-grained control over agent behavior.

read_only_flag.semantics: No separate boolean read_only flag exists on this host (unlike Cursor's readonly). Read-only isolation is achieved by omitting write/edit tools from the tools allowlist.

provenance.caveat: Absence across the full changelog and reachable documentation. Enforced by tool allowlist omission.

hooks.semantics: Per-agent frontmatter hooks are not supported for custom agents; lifecycle hooks are configured at the plugin or project level via hooks.json.

provenance.quote: Hooks defined in plugins/<name>/hooks.json are registered and run during the agent's lifecycle.

mcpServers.semantics: Per-agent inline MCP server configuration is not supported in frontmatter; MCP servers are configured in mcp_config.json or bundled in plugins.

provenance.quote: MCP Servers defined in plugins/<name>/mcp_config.json are launched, and their tools are made available.

delegation.mechanism: The invoke_subagent tool present in the agent's tools allowlist. Invocation accepts an array of subagent specifications (Prompt, Role, TypeName, Model: inherit|flash_lite|flash|pro, Workspace: inherit|branch|share). Selecting Workspace: branch creates an isolated git worktree per invocation.

nested.gate: invoke_subagent present in the dispatched agent's own tools allowlist.

provenance.quote: Added support for displaying nested subagents (grandchild and deeper) and handling tool confirmation requests across all subagent depths by recursively relaying nested subtrajectory updates to the root conversation.
provenance.caveat: max_depth is null because no hard limit is published in first-party documentation; recursive relaying operates across all subagent depths.

provenance.quote: Fixed `invoke_subagent`, `send_message`, `manage_subagents`, `define_subagent`, and `generate_image` rendering with no tool call line at all in collapsed and expanded tool groups

mailbox.mechanism: The send_message tool addressed by conversation ID, with asynchronous delivery to idle subagents. The parent agent receives notifications upon subagent message or task completion without requiring active polling loops.

provenance.quote: Fixed subagents sometimes appearing stuck in a running state after they had finished — especially in very large conversations — which also left queued when-idle messages undelivered until restart.

notes: Field-level contract with official documentation from https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/overview and the official google-antigravity/antigravity-cli CHANGELOG.

Subagent dispatch is performed via invoke_subagent, taking an array of subagent definitions (Prompt, Role, TypeName, Workspace, Model). Workspace supports 'inherit' (default parent directory), 'branch' (isolated git worktree), or 'share' (shared underlying storage).
Subagent communication is performed via send_message(Recipient=<conversationId>, Message=<text>).
Subagent supervision and cancellation is performed via manage_subagents(Action='list'|'kill'|'kill_all', ConversationIds=[...]).

Repo-native state tools (scripts/job_queue.py, scripts/mailbox.py, scripts/dispatch_state.py, scripts/check_return.py) run as Python commands within the agent environment, governed by standard environment variables (ROOT_ARCHITECT_HOST=gemini, ROOT_ARCHITECT_STATE_DIR=.root-architect).
